query: Las Vegas Festival Grounds is north of the hotel that is owned by which company?

pipeline_result.response: Las Vegas Festival Grounds is north of the MGM-owned Circus Circus Hotel and Casino in Winchester, Nevada.
retrieved_context: Las Vegas Festival Grounds: Las Vegas Festival Grounds (formerly MGM Resorts Festival Grounds) is a 33 acre open-air venue located on the Las Vegas Strip, north of the MGM-owned Circus Circus Hotel and Casino in Winchester, Nevada.

Stratosphere Las Vegas: The Stratosphere Las Vegas (formerly Vegas World) is a hotel, casino, and tower located on Las Vegas Boulevard just north of the Las Vegas Strip in Las Vegas, Nevada, United States.

Flamingo Las Vegas: Flamingo Las Vegas (formerly The Fabulous Flamingo and Flamingo Hilton Las Vegas) is a hotel and casino located on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada.  It is owned and operated by Caesars Entertainment Corporation.
